dcterms:description: This dataset consists of over 400,000 question pairs, and each question pair is annotated with a binary value indicating whether the two questions are paraphrase of each other. The dataset is split into training, development, and test sets.
dcterms:title: Quora Question Pairs

dcterms:description: The SNLI dataset contains 570,152 sentence pairs, each labeled with one of the following relationships: entailment, contradiction, neutral. The dataset is used for natural language inference tasks.
dcterms:title: SNLI

dcterms:creator: Adina Williams
Nikita Nangia
Samuel R Bowman
dcterms:description: The MultiNLI dataset is a natural language inference dataset that contains 392,702 pairs for training, with matched and mismatched examples for evaluation.
dcterms:title: MultiNLI

dcterms:description: SQuAD is a reading comprehension dataset where the answer to each question is a span of text from the corresponding passage. The dataset is used for evaluating answer sentence selection tasks.
dcterms:title: SQuAD
